book_name: 外研版高中英语 必修3

words.tr:
prep. 穿过；横过；在…对面；
adv. 横过；穿过；越过；
words.ex: He walked across the street.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过街道。
words.en: From one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

words.ex: He put the suitcase in the boot of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李箱放进了汽车的后备箱里。
words.en: A boot is a type of shoe that covers the whole foot and the lower part of the leg. It can also mean to kick something forcefully or to start a computer.

words.tr: adj. 欧洲大陆的；大陆的；
words.ex: He prefers continental breakfast with bread and coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢欧洲大陆式的早餐，有面包和咖啡。
words.en: Continental is used to describe something that relates to or is characteristic of a continent, especially the mainland of Europe as distinct from the British Isles.

words.ex: He must face his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: The front part of a person's head from the forehead to the chin, or the corresponding part in an animal.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.ex: The invention of the wheel was a landmark in human history.
words.ex_cn: 轮子的发明是人类历史上的一个里程碑。
words.en: A landmark is a building or feature of a landscape that is easily seen and recognized from a distance, especially one that enables someone to establish their location.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.tr: adj. 位于…的；处于…的境地的； v. 使位于；使坐落于；“situate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The house is situated near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子位于湖边。
words.en: If something is situated in a particular place or position, it is in that place or position.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: A symbol is a shape or design that is used to represent something such as an idea, a quality, or a process.

words.tr: v. 位于；使坐落于；查找…的地点；确定…的位置；“locate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 坐落在；位于；
words.ex: The school is located near the park.
words.ex_cn: 学校位于公园附近。
words.en: If something is located in a particular place, it is in that place.

words.ex: He is an architect who designs houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位设计房屋的建筑师。
words.en: An architect is a person who designs buildings and advises in their construction.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.tr: n. 雕刻（术）；雕塑品；雕刻品；
words.ex: He made a beautiful sculpture from clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏土做了一件精美的雕刻。
words.en: Sculpture is the art of making two- or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms, especially by carving stone or wood or by casting metal or plaster.

words.ex: This village is the birthplace of the famous poet.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄是这位著名诗人的发源地。
words.en: The place where someone was born.

words.ex: Ancient Egypt is one of the oldest civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: A civilization is a human society with its own social organization and culture.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built the pyramids.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人建造了金字塔。
words.en: Belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.

words.tr:
n. 反面；对立面；
adj. 对面的；
prep. 与…相对；
words.ex: The opposite of black is white.
words.ex_cn: 黑色的反面是白色。
words.en: If one thing is opposite another, it is on the other side of a space from it.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.ex: They signed an agreement to share the costs.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份分担费用的协议。
words.en: An agreement is a formal decision about future action which is made by two or more people, groups, or organizations.

words.tr: adv. （用以询问大概的地方）在什么地方；
words.ex: I don't know his whereabouts.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他在什么地方。
words.en: The place where someone or something is.

words.ex: The king governed the land for 50 years.
words.ex_cn: 国王统治这个国家50年。
words.en: To govern a country or an organization means to officially control and manage its affairs.

words.tr:
n. 头；脑袋；上端；首脑；
v. 朝…行进；居首位；领导；
adj. 头的；主要的；
words.ex: He hurt his head when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了头。
words.en: The upper part of the human body, or the front or upper part of the body of an animal, typically separated from the rest of the body by a neck, and containing the brain, mouth, and sense organs.

words.tr:
n. 代表；典型事物；
adj. 典型的；有代表性的；代议制的；
words.ex: He is the representative of our class.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们班的代表。
words.en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

words.ex: The parliament passed a new law about education.
words.ex_cn: 国会通过了一项关于教育的新法律。
words.en: A parliament is a legislative body of government, typically composed of elected representatives, that is responsible for making laws and representing the interests of the people.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.ex: The map shows geographical features like mountains and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了山脉和河流等地貌特征。
words.en: Relating to the study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.tr:
v. 生产；制造；导致；引起；生育；出示；
n. 农产品；
words.ex: The farm produces fresh vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个农场每天生产新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: To produce something means to make, create, or manufacture it, often in large quantities. It can also refer to the act of causing something to happen or exist.

words.ex: He felt hunger after running for an hour.
words.ex_cn: 他跑了一个小时后感到饥饿。
words.en: A strong desire or need for food.

words.ex: His income is enough to pay for rent and food.
words.ex_cn: 他的收入足以支付房租和食物。
words.en: Income is the money that a person or a company earns regularly, for example from investment or work.

words.ex: Many children suffer from poverty in poor countries.
words.ex_cn: 许多孩子在贫穷国家遭受贫困。
words.en: Poverty is the state of being extremely poor.

words.tr:
adj. 人的；人类的；
n. 人；人类；
words.ex: Human emotions are complex and powerful.
words.ex_cn: 人的情感复杂而强大。
words.en: A human is a member of the species Homo sapiens, distinguished from other animals by superior mental development, power of articulate speech, and upright stance.

words.ex: The development of the town took many years.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的发展花了许多年。
words.en: Development is the process of growth, progress, or making something more advanced.

words.ex: The index of 2 in 2^3 is 3.
words.ex_cn: 2^3 中 2 的指数是 3。
words.en: An index is a system by which changes in the value of something and the rate at which it changes can be recorded, measured, or interpreted.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.tr: n. 目标；进球得分；球门；
words.ex: His goal is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A goal is an aim or purpose that a person or a group of people is trying to achieve.

words.ex: He has high expectancy for the future.
words.ex_cn: 他对未来有很高的预期。
words.en: The feeling of excitement about something that is going to happen.

words.tr: n. 位置；职位；地位；姿势；
words.ex: The book is on the table in a good position.
words.ex_cn: 书放在桌子上的一个好位置。
words.en: A position refers to the place or type of role someone has in a situation, organization, or society, or the way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.

words.ex: They want to educate their children well.
words.ex_cn: 他们想好好教育自己的孩子。
words.en: To educate someone means to teach them over a period of time at a school, college, or university.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；
adj. 家庭的；
words.ex: This household has three children.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭有三个孩子。
words.en: A household is all the people in a family or group who live together in a house.

words.ex: The homeless man slept on the bench.
words.ex_cn: 那个无家可归的人睡在长椅上。
words.en: If someone is homeless, they have no permanent place to live.

words.ex: The charity helps poor children get food and education.
words.ex_cn: 这个慈善团体帮助贫困儿童获得食物和教育。
words.en: An organization that helps people in need, or the act of giving money, food, or help to those who need it.

words.tr: adj. 拥挤的；密集的； v. “crowd”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bus was crowded during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段公交车很拥挤。
words.en: If a place is crowded, it is full of people.

words.ex: He drives on the freeway every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都开上高速公路。
words.en: A freeway is a wide road built for fast travel between cities or towns, with a limited number of places where vehicles can enter and leave it.

words.ex: The inhabitant lives in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 这位居民住在一所小房子里。
words.en: An inhabitant of a place is one of the people who live there.

words.ex: The similarity between the two paintings is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这两幅画的相似点很明显。
words.en: The quality or state of being similar; likeness or resemblance.

words.ex: It was unfortunate that he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他没赶上公交车，真是不幸。
words.en: If you describe someone as unfortunate, you mean that something unpleasant or unlucky has happened to them. You can also describe the unpleasant things that happen to them as unfortunate.

words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.ex: Tourism brings money to small towns.
words.ex_cn: 旅游业为小镇带来收入。
words.en: Tourism is the business of providing services for people on holiday, for example hotels, restaurants, and trips.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.ex: The city has many industrial factories.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有许多工业工厂。
words.en: Industrial means relating to or characterized by industry.

words.tr: adj. 被污染的； v. “pollute”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The river is polluted by factory waste.
words.ex_cn: 这条河被工厂废料污染了。
words.en: If something is polluted, it is made dirty or harmful, usually because of chemicals or waste.

words.tr: adj. 聪明的；时髦的；衣冠楚楚的；
words.ex: He is a smart student who solves math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个聪明的学生，能快速解决数学问题。
words.en: If you describe someone as smart, you mean that they are clean, tidy, and stylish in their appearance.

words.tr: adj. 巨大的；大量的；辽阔的；
words.ex: The desert is vast and empty.
words.ex_cn: 这片沙漠巨大而空旷。
words.en: If you describe something as vast, you mean that it is very large.

words.ex: Watching movies is a popular entertainment.
words.ex_cn: 看电影是一种流行的休闲娱乐。
words.en: Entertainment refers to performances or activities that are intended to amuse or interest an audience.

words.tr:
n. 交换；兑换；交易所；
v. 交换；
words.ex: They made an exchange of books.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了书籍的交换。
words.en: If you exchange something, you give it to someone and receive something else in return.

words.ex: The earthquake caused a big disaster.
words.ex_cn: 地震造成了一场大灾难。
words.en: A disaster is an unexpected event causing great damage, destruction, or distress.

words.tr:
n. 洪水；水灾；
v. 淹没；泛滥；
words.ex: The heavy rain caused a flood in the village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨导致了村庄发生洪水。
words.en: A flood is an overflow of water that submerges land which is usually dry. In the sense of 'flowing water', the word may also be applied to the inflow of the tide.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

words.ex: The lightning struck the tree last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚闪电击中了那棵树。
words.en: A flash of light in the sky caused by the discharge of atmospheric electricity from one cloud to another or between a cloud and the earth.

words.ex: The thunderstorm woke us up at night.
words.ex_cn: 雷雨在夜里把我们吵醒了。
words.en: A thunderstorm is a storm with thunder and lightning and typically also heavy rain or hail.

words.ex: The tornado destroyed the small house.
words.ex_cn: 龙卷风摧毁了那座小房子。
words.en: A tornado is a violent windstorm characterized by a twisting, funnel-shaped cloud.

words.ex: The ancient temple has a tall stone column.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙有一根高大的石柱。
words.en: A column is a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a monument.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.tr:
v. 导致；引起；
n. 原因；理由；事业；
words.ex: Smoking can cause lung disease.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会导致肺癌。
words.en: The cause of something is what makes it happen or exist.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.ex: The city is at a latitude of 40 degrees north.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度。
words.en: Latitude is the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The room has new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有新家具。
words.en: Furniture refers to the movable objects intended to support various human activities such as seating, eating, and sleeping.

words.ex: They bury the dead in the cemetery.
words.ex_cn: 他们把死者埋葬在墓地里。
words.en: To bury something means to put it into a hole in the ground and cover it up, often in order to hide it or to put it to rest.

words.ex: The bird has a soft feather.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟有一根柔软的羽毛。
words.en: One of the light, horny structures that form the principal covering of birds.

words.ex: The coat is made of soft fur.
words.ex_cn: 这件外套是由柔软的毛皮制成的。
words.en: The thick hair that covers the bodies of some animals, or the hair-covered skin(s) of animals, used in making clothes and other items.

words.ex: The accident occurred yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 事故昨天发生了。
words.en: If something occurs, it happens.

words.ex: He lives in a tropical island near the equator.
words.ex_cn: 他住在赤道附近的一个热带岛屿上。
words.en: relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator)

words.ex: The equator divides the Earth into two halves.
words.ex_cn: 赤道将地球分为两半。
words.en: The equator is an imaginary line around the Earth, equally distant from the North Pole and the South Pole, dividing the Earth into the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere.

words.ex: The fan is rotating slowly.
words.ex_cn: 风扇正在缓慢地转动。
words.en: Moving or turning around a central point or axis.

words.ex: The violent storm destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场暴力的风暴摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: If someone is violent, or if they do something that is violent, they use physical force or weapons to hurt, injure, or kill other people.

words.tr:
n. 波；波浪；海浪；
v. 挥手；挥舞；招手；
words.ex: The wave hit the shore softly.
words.ex_cn: 波浪轻轻拍打着海岸。
words.en: A wave is a raised line of water that moves across the surface of the sea or a lake. To wave means to move your hand or arm from side to side in the air, usually in order to say hello or goodbye to someone.

words.tr:
n. 袭击；罢工；
v. 击打；侵袭；突然想到；
words.ex: The strike on the base happened at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 对基地的袭击发生在黎明时分。
words.en: To hit someone or something forcefully; to stop work as a form of protest.

words.ex: The old cemetery is near the church.
words.ex_cn: 那个古老的墓地在教堂附近。
words.en: A cemetery is a place where dead people are buried.

words.ex: He saw a wooden coffin at the funeral.
words.ex_cn: 他在葬礼上看到一个木制棺材。
words.en: A coffin is a box in which a dead body is buried or cremated.

words.tr:
n. 废墟；
v. 破坏；
words.ex: The old temple is now a ruin.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙现在已成为废墟。
words.en: Ruin means the physical destruction or disintegration of something or the state of disintegrating or being destroyed.

words.ex: The fire left ash on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 火在地面上留下了灰烬。
words.en: the powdery residue left after the burning of a substance

words.ex: The volcano erupts suddenly.
words.ex_cn: 火山突然喷发。
words.en: If a volcano erupts, it throws out smoke, fire, and melted rocks.

words.ex: The volcano spilled hot lava down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 火山喷出炽热的岩浆流下山。
words.en: Lava is the molten rock that comes out of a volcano during an eruption.

words.tr: adj. 受潮水影响的；有潮的；
words.ex: The tidal beach changes with the tide.
words.ex_cn: 这个受潮水影响的海滩随着潮水变化。
words.en: relating to or affected by tides

words.ex: The volcano erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.ex: He read the previous chapter last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了前一章。
words.en: Existing or occurring before in time or order.

words.ex: The volcano had a big eruption last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周这座火山发生了大喷发。
words.en: An eruption is a sudden, often violent, outburst or discharge, such as that of a volcano, emotion, or conflict.

words.ex: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天有可能下雨。
words.en: A possibility is a situation that might happen or something that might be true.

words.ex: The earthquake shook the houses last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚地震震动了房屋。
words.en: An earthquake is a sudden shaking of the ground caused by the passage of seismic waves through Earth's rocks.

words.tr: adj. 令人害怕的；令人恐惧的； v. “terrify”的现在分词；
words.ex: The dark forest looked terrifying at night.
words.ex_cn: 那个黑暗的森林在晚上看起来令人害怕。
words.en: If you describe something as terrifying, you mean that it makes you feel extremely frightened.

words.ex: Luckily, the bus came just in time.
words.ex_cn: 幸运的是，公交车正好及时到了。
words.en: You use luckily to indicate that something good has happened because of chance or luck, rather than because of someone's skill or planning.

words.ex: Thankfully, the rain stopped before we left.
words.ex_cn: 幸亏雨在我们出发前停了。
words.en: In a way that expresses gratitude or relief.

words.ex: Hopefully, it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 但愿明天会下雨。
words.en: If you say that something will happen hopefully, you mean that you wish it to happen or you think it is likely to happen.

words.ex: He sadly said goodbye to his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他伤心地跟他的狗说了再见。
words.en: In a manner that expresses sorrow or unhappiness.

words.ex: Fortunately, the bus came just in time.
words.ex_cn: 幸运的是，公交车正好准时到了。
words.en: Used to say that something good has happened, especially when it could have been bad.

words.tr: n. 警示； v. 警告；“warn”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sign gave a warning about the slippery road.
words.ex_cn: 标志提醒了道路湿滑的警示。
words.en: A warning is something which is said or written to tell people of a possible danger, problem, or other unpleasant thing that might happen.

words.tr:
adv. 全球性地；
adj. 全球性的；
words.ex: The news spread worldwide overnight.
words.ex_cn: 这则新闻一夜之间传遍全球。
words.en: Something that is worldwide exists or happens in all parts of the world.

words.tr: adj. 活跃的；积极的；主动的；
words.ex: He is an active student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上是一个活跃的学生。
words.en: Someone who is active moves around a lot or does a lot of things.

words.tr:
n. 损害；破损；
v. 损害；破坏；
words.ex: The storm caused serious damage to the house.
words.ex_cn: 风暴对房屋造成了严重损害。
words.en: Damage is physical harm that is caused to something which makes it less attractive, useful, or valuable.

words.ex: The sandstorm covered the whole city.
words.ex_cn: 沙尘暴覆盖了整个城市。
words.en: A sandstorm is a strong wind in a desert that carries clouds of sand with it, often making it difficult to see or breathe.

words.tr: adj. 引起恐惧的；使惊恐的；骇人的； v. “frighten”的现在分词；
words.ex: The dark forest looked frightening at night.
words.ex_cn: 那个黑暗的森林在晚上看起来很吓人。
words.en: If you say that something is frightening, you mean that it makes you feel afraid or anxious.

words.tr:
adj. 内陆的；
adv. 向内地；在内陆；
n. 内地；内陆；
words.ex: The small village is located inland, far from the sea.
words.ex_cn: 这个小村庄位于内陆，远离大海。
words.en: Inland means situated in the interior of a country rather than on the coast.

words.tr:
adj. 大规模的；大量的；
n. 大量；质量；块；群；团；
words.ex: The company launched a mass production line to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 该公司启动了大规模生产线以满足需求。
words.en: A mass is a large amount of something that has no particular shape or arrangement.

words.tr: n. （政治、商业或社会性）活动；运动；
words.ex: The city launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市发起了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
words.en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

words.ex: The children played on the big dune near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海边的大沙丘上玩耍。
words.en: A dune is a hill of sand near the sea or in a desert, formed by the wind.

words.ex: Overgrazing causes desertification in dry areas.
words.ex_cn: 过度放牧会导致干旱地区的沙漠化。
words.en: Desertification is the process by which fertile land becomes desert, typically as a result of drought, deforestation, or inappropriate agriculture.

words.tr:
n. 工序；过程；
v. 处理；加工；
words.ex: The factory improved the production process.
words.ex_cn: 工厂改进了生产工序。
words.en: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

words.ex: Every citizen must follow the law.
words.ex_cn: 每个公民都必须遵守法律。
words.en: A citizen is a person who is legally recognized as a member of a country or state, either by birth or by naturalization, and who is entitled to its protection and privileges.

words.ex: The worker wore a mask to avoid breathing in dust.
words.ex_cn: 这位工人戴上口罩以避免吸入粉尘。
words.en: Dust is a layer of fine, dry particles on the surface of something, or the fine, dry particles themselves.

words.tr:
n. 预测；预报；
v. 预测；预报；
words.ex: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: If you forecast future events, you say what you think is going to happen in the future.

words.ex: His strength helped him lift the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他的力量让他举起了那个重箱子。
words.en: The quality or state of being physically strong.

words.tr:
n. 循环；周期；自行车；
v. 骑自行车；循环；
words.ex: The water cycle is important for nature.
words.ex_cn: 水循环对自然界很重要。
words.en: A cycle is a series of events that are regularly repeated in the same order or a bicycle.

words.ex: He wore a scary mask at the Halloween party.
words.ex_cn: 他在万圣节派对上戴了一个可怕的面具。
words.en: A mask is a piece of cloth or other material that you wear over your face to hide or protect it.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: Carbon is an element in all living things.
words.ex_cn: 碳是所有生物体中的一种元素。
words.en: Carbon is a chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6. It is nonmetallic and tetravalent—making four electrons available to form covalent chemical bonds.

words.ex: Carbon dioxide makes the air warm.
words.ex_cn: 二氧化碳使空气变暖。
words.en: A compound containing two atoms of oxygen combined with another element or group.

words.tr:
adj. 化学的；
n. 化学品；
words.ex: The lab has a chemical reaction.
words.ex_cn: 实验室里有一个化学反应。
words.en: A chemical is a substance that is used in or produced by a process involving chemistry.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.ex: The children threw garbage on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔在地上。
words.en: Waste material; unwanted or undesired material.

words.ex: The ice melts in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 冰在阳光下融化。
words.en: If a solid substance melts or if you melt it, it changes to a liquid, usually because it has been heated.

words.ex: The river is dirty because of pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这条河因为污染而变得肮脏。
words.en: Pollution is the process of making air, water, soil, etc. dirty and not safe or suitable to use.

words.ex: We recycle plastic bottles every week.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周回收塑料瓶。
words.en: To recycle means to process used materials so that they can be used again.

words.ex: The coastal village has beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 这个沿海村庄有美丽的海滩。
words.en: relating to the coast, the area where the land meets the sea

words.tr: adj. 担心的；关注的； v. 涉及到；“concern”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My parents are concerned about my grades.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母对我的成绩感到担心。
words.en: If you are concerned about something, you are worried about it.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；
n. 大调；主修课；
words.ex: Math is a major subject in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学是学校里的主要科目。
words.en: A major is a student's principal field of study or specialization in college or university.

words.ex: The doctor said the patient needs urgent care.
words.ex_cn: 医生说病人需要紧急治疗。
words.en: If something is urgent, it needs to be dealt with as soon as possible.

words.ex: The factory pollutes the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂污染了这条河。
words.en: To pollute water, air, or land means to make it dirty and dangerous to live in or to use, especially with poisonous chemicals or waste.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都抱怨噪音太大。
words.en: To express dissatisfaction, pain, or resentment, usually because of a particular situation or someone's actions.

words.ex: The nut broke open in its nutshell.
words.ex_cn: 坚果在它的坚果壳里裂开了。
words.en: A nutshell is the hard outer covering of a nut. In a nutshell is used to indicate that something is being described in a very brief way.

words.ex: The dark forest looks scary at night.
words.ex_cn: 这个黑暗的森林在晚上看起来吓人。
words.en: If something is scary, it causes fear or alarm.

words.ex: He is absolutely sure about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对确定这个答案。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is completely true or correct.

words.ex: The helmet gives protection to his head.
words.ex_cn: 头盔保护他的头部。
words.en: Protection is the act of protecting someone or something, or the state of being protected.

words.tr:
adj. 相等的；同等的；
v. 等于；比得上；
words.ex: Two plus two is equal to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: If two things are equal, or if one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.ex: The importance of homework is clear.
words.ex_cn: 作业的重要性是显而易见的。
words.en: The quality or state of being important; significance.

words.ex: The philosopher wrote a book about life.
words.ex_cn: 这位哲学家写了一本关于生活的书。
words.en: A philosopher is a person who studies or writes about philosophy.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.tr: n. 教学；授课；教导； v. 教；教导；“teach”的现在分词；
words.ex: Teaching is his favorite part of the job.
words.ex_cn: 教学是他工作中最喜欢的部分。
words.en: The work or profession of a teacher; the act of imparting knowledge or skills.

words.ex: He is a deep thinker who solves problems slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个深思熟虑的思考者，慢慢解决问题。
words.en: A thinker is someone who spends a lot of time thinking deeply about important things, especially someone who is famous for thinking of new or interesting ideas.

words.ex: Her kindness helped me when I was sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我不开心时，她的善意帮助了我。
words.en: Kindness is the quality of being gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.tr:
n. 顺序；条理；命令；订单；(生物学的)目；
v. 订购；命令；点餐；整理；
words.ex: The books are in alphabetical order.
words.ex_cn: 这些书是按字母顺序排列的。
words.en: If you order someone to do something, you tell them to do it in a way that they have to obey. Order can also refer to the way things are arranged or a request to make or supply something.

words.ex: He always follows the principle of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遵循诚实的原则。
words.en: A principle is a basic idea or rule that explains or controls how something happens or works.

words.tr: n. 位置；职位；地位；姿势；
words.ex: The book is on the table in a good position.
words.ex_cn: 书放在桌子上的一个好位置。
words.en: A position refers to the place or type of role someone has in a situation, organization, or society, or the way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.

words.tr:
n. 压力；强调；
v. 着重；强调；
words.ex: He feels stress from too much work.
words.ex_cn: 他因为工作太多而感到压力。
words.en: Stress is a state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

words.tr: v. 辞职；使…顺从于（做）某事；
words.ex: He decided to resign from his job.
words.ex_cn: 他决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you resign from a job or position, you formally announce that you are leaving it.

words.ex: He is an adviser to the government.
words.ex_cn: 他是政府的顾问。
words.en: An adviser is a person who gives advice, especially someone who knows a lot about a particular subject.

words.ex: He is an influential teacher in our school.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们学校一位有影响力的老师。
words.en: Having great influence on someone or something.

words.tr:
v. 热爱；爱；
n. 爱；爱情；爱好的事物；
words.ex: I love playing football with my friends.
words.ex_cn: 我热爱和朋友们一起踢足球。
words.en: Love is a very strong feeling of affection towards someone that you are romantically or sexually attracted to.

words.ex: Honesty is important in friendship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实在友谊中很重要。
words.en: The quality of being honest, which involves being truthful, sincere, and free from deceit or fraud.

words.ex: The judge made a fair decision to show justice.
words.ex_cn: 法官做出了公正的裁决以体现公正。
words.en: Justice is fairness in the way that people are treated.

words.tr:
n. 树皮；
v. 狗吠；
words.ex: The dog climbed the tree and touched the bark.
words.ex_cn: 狗爬上了树，摸了摸树皮。
words.en: The sound a dog makes; the outer covering of a tree.

words.ex: His contribution helped the team win.
words.ex_cn: 他的贡献帮助团队赢得了比赛。
words.en: A contribution is a gift or payment to a common fund or collection, or the part played by a person or thing in bringing about a result or helping something to advance.

words.ex: He invented a new machine to clean the house.
words.ex_cn: 他发明了一台新机器来打扫房子。
words.en: To invent something means to design or create it, especially something that has never been made before.

words.ex: He bought a leather jacket for winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天买了一件皮夹克。
words.en: Leather is a material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.

words.ex: The monk meditates every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位僧侣每天早上冥想。
words.en: A monk is a member of a religious community of men who live by certain vows and usually wear a habit.

words.ex: The pillow is soft and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这个枕头很软，很舒服。
words.en: Something that is soft is pleasant to touch, and not rough or hard.

words.ex: This book belongs to the science category.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于科学类别。
words.en: A category is a class or group of things that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: He reads an ancient Buddhist sutra every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读一本古老的佛教经文。
words.en: A sutra is a religious teaching or a scriptural narrative, especially one of the discourses of the Buddha.

words.tr: n. 发明家；发明者；创造者；
words.ex: Thomas Edison was a famous inventor.
words.ex_cn: 托马斯·爱迪生是一位著名的发明家。
words.en: An inventor is a person who has invented something, or whose job is to invent things.

words.ex: His argument was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他的论点清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: An argument is a discussion or debate in which people express different opinions about something.

words.ex: He wants freedom to speak his mind.
words.ex_cn: 他想要自由地表达自己的想法。
words.en: The condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.ex: His condition improved after the treatment.
words.ex_cn: 他的状况在接受治疗后好转了。
words.en: A condition is a state of affairs that must exist or be brought about before something else can happen or be done.

words.tr: n. 公告；布告；公报；新闻简报；
words.ex: The school posted a bulletin about the holiday schedule.
words.ex_cn: 学校张贴了一份关于假期安排的公告。
words.en: A bulletin is a short news report on the radio or television. A bulletin is also a short printed newspaper or leaflet that gives information about a particular group or organization.

words.ex: The boat travels through the canal.
words.ex_cn: 船通过运河航行。
words.en: A canal is a long, narrow stretch of water that has been made for boats to travel along or to bring water to a particular area.

words.tr: adj. 国内的；公民的；民用的；
words.ex: The country is recovering from a civil war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在从一场内战中恢复。
words.en: relating to ordinary citizens and their concerns, as distinct from military or ecclesiastical matters.

words.ex: The hiker stood at the edge of the cliff.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者站在悬崖边上。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river.

words.ex: The dam holds back the river water.
words.ex_cn: 水坝拦住了河水。
words.en: A dam is a barrier that stops or restricts the flow of water or underground streams. Reservoirs created by dams not only suppress floods but also provide water for activities such as irrigation, human consumption, industrial use, aquaculture, and navigability.

words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.ex: The hikers walked through a deep gorge.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者走过一个深峡谷。
words.en: A gorge is a deep, narrow valley with steep sides, often carved by a river. It can also refer to the act of eating greedily.

words.ex: The dam produces hydroelectric power for the city.
words.ex_cn: 这座水坝为城市提供水力发电。
words.en: Relating to the generation of electricity by the force of fast-moving water, such as rivers or waterfalls.

words.ex: The reservoir provides water for the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 这个水库为附近的城镇提供水源。
words.en: A reservoir is a large quantity of a substance that is stored and can be used when needed.

words.tr:
n. 结构；建筑物；
v. 组织；
words.ex: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥的结构非常坚固。
words.en: The arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex.

words.ex: The bus stops at the terminal at 9 PM.
words.ex_cn: 公交车晚上9点到达终点站。
words.en: A terminal is a place where vehicles, passengers, or goods begin or end a journey. It can also refer to a computer device at which a user enters data or commands.

words.tr:
n. 日期；年代；约会；枣子；枣椰树；
v. 标日期；约会；追溯到；过时；
words.ex: What is the date today?
words.ex_cn: 今天是几号？
words.en: A date is a specific day of the month or year, which can be identified by a particular name or number.

words.tr: v. 容纳；适应；为...提供住宿；
words.ex: The hotel can accommodate 200 guests.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店能容纳200位客人。
words.en: If a building or space can accommodate someone or something, it has enough room for them.

words.tr: n. 雕刻品；雕刻图案； v. 雕刻；“carve”的现在分词；
words.ex: The museum displayed a beautiful wooden carving.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展示了一件精美的木雕品。
words.en: A carving is an object or design that has been cut out of a material such as wood or stone.

words.ex: The construction of the new bridge took two years.
words.ex_cn: 新桥的建筑花了两年时间。
words.en: The process or method of building or making something, especially buildings, bridges, etc.

words.ex: The old temple is a relic from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙是来自古代的遗迹。
words.en: An object surviving from an earlier time, especially one of historical or sentimental interest.

words.ex: The site of the old church is now a park.
words.ex_cn: 旧教堂的位置现在是一个公园。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.tr:
adj. 佛教的；佛法的；佛教徒的；
n. 佛教徒；佛门弟子；
words.ex: He visited a Buddhist temple in Thailand.
words.ex_cn: 他去了泰国的一座佛教寺庙。
words.en: A Buddhist is someone who follows the teachings of Buddhism.

words.ex: The wind generates electricity.
words.ex_cn: 风产生电力。
words.en: To generate something means to cause it to begin and develop.

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 马具；
words.ex: We must harness the power of the sun.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须利用太阳的能量。
words.en: A harness is a set of straps which fit under a person's arms and fasten round their body in order to keep a piece of equipment in place or to prevent the person moving from a place.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.tr:
adj. 狭窄的；窄小的；
v. 使窄小；
words.ex: The road is narrow and hard to drive on.
words.ex_cn: 这条路很窄，开车很难。
words.en: If something narrows, or if you narrow it, it becomes less wide.

words.ex: He wrote a short poem for his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他为母亲写了一首短诗。
words.en: A poem is a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their beauty and sound and are carefully arranged, often in short lines which rhyme.

words.ex: The diver submerge to explore the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 潜水员潜水去探索珊瑚礁。
words.en: To submerge something means to put it below the surface of a liquid, especially water. If something submerges, it goes below the surface of a liquid.

words.ex: The problem is a global issue.
words.ex_cn: 这个问题是一个全球性的问题。
words.en: relating to the whole world; worldwide

words.ex: The guard stood on the watchtower.
words.ex_cn: 守卫站在瞭望塔上。
words.en: A watchtower is a tall structure from which people can look out for enemies or intruders.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.tr: adj. 极冷的；冰冻的； v. 结冰；冻结；“freeze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The weather is freezing today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气极冷。
words.en: If you say that something is freezing, you are emphasizing that it is very cold.

words.ex: It's ridiculous to think he can run a mile in one minute.
words.ex_cn: 认为他能在一分钟内跑完一英里是荒谬的。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is ridiculous, you mean that they are very foolish.

words.ex: The elephant is enormous.
words.ex_cn: 这头大象非常巨大。
words.en: If you describe something as enormous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely large in size or amount.

words.ex: Scientists work at the observatory to study stars.
words.ex_cn: 科学家在天文台工作以研究恒星。
words.en: A building or place equipped for observation of natural phenomena (as in astronomy); also : an institution whose primary purpose is making such observations.

words.ex: The morning was foggy, so I could not see the road.
words.ex_cn: 早晨有雾，所以我看不到路。
words.en: If it is foggy, there is fog.

words.tr:
n. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃；
v. 碰撞；坠毁；崩溃；
words.ex: The car crash happened at the intersection.
words.ex_cn: 汽车碰撞发生在十字路口。
words.en: If a vehicle crashes or if the driver crashes it, it hits something and is damaged or destroyed.

words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.ex: He is known as a great teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他被称为一位优秀的老师。
words.en: If someone or something is known as a particular name, they are called by that name.

words.ex: He has been happy ever since he moved to the city.
words.ex_cn: 自从他搬到城市以来，他一直很快乐。
words.en: From a particular time in the past until the present.

words.tr: phrase. 就...而言；在...方面；根据
words.ex: In terms of cost, this phone is cheaper.
words.ex_cn: 从成本来看，这部手机更便宜。
words.en: used to indicate what aspect of a subject you are talking about

words.ex: I like coffee, on the other hand, my brother prefers tea.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，另一方面，我弟弟更喜欢茶。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously

words.tr: phrase. 逐渐地；一点一点地；慢慢地
words.ex: He learned to swim little by little.
words.ex_cn: 他一点一点地学会了游泳。
words.en: Gradually; in small stages or increments.

words.ex: The flag is at the top of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 旗帜在山顶上。
words.en: At the highest part or point of something.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的底部；在……的尽头
words.ex: The cat is at the bottom of the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 猫在楼梯底部。
words.en: At the lowest part or point of something.

words.tr: phrase. 努力；作出努力；尽力
words.ex: He makes efforts to learn English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力学习英语。
words.en: To exert oneself physically or mentally in order to achieve something.

words.tr: phrase. 有关系；和…连在一起
words.ex: This event is connected with the history of the city.
words.ex_cn: v. 这个事件与城市的历史有联系。
words.en: To be related to or associated with someone or something.

words.ex_cn: 学校离公园很近。
words.en: To be near in space, time, or relationship.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.ex: On average, children sleep 10 hours a night.
words.ex_cn: 平均而言，儿童每天睡10个小时。
words.en: If you say that something is true on average, you mean that it is generally the case.

words.tr: phrase. 结束；告终；意外到达
words.ex: He didn't plan to stay, but he ended up sleeping there.
words.ex_cn: 他本没打算留下，但最后在那里睡了。
words.en: If you end up in a particular place or situation, you are in that place or situation after a series of events, even though you did not originally intend to be.

words.ex: He set fire to the paper in the trash can.
words.ex_cn: 他在垃圾桶里点燃了那张纸。
words.en: To cause something to start burning.

words.ex: The paper caught fire quickly.
words.ex_cn: 纸很快着火了。
words.en: To begin to burn; to ignite.

words.tr: phrase. 扑灭；熄掉；伸出；发表；恼怒
words.ex: He put out the fire with a blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他用毯子扑灭了火。
words.en: To extinguish a fire or light; to publish or produce something; to extend or stretch out something.

words.ex: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

words.ex: He has ten apples in all.
words.ex_cn: 他一共有十个苹果。
words.en: You use in all to emphasize that something is the total amount or number involved.

words.ex: They cut down the old tree in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们把院子里那棵老树砍倒了。
words.en: To reduce the amount, size, or number of something, or to do less of something.

words.tr: phrase. 被困在……中；遭遇（如暴雨、交通堵塞等）
words.ex: He was caught in the rain without an umbrella.
words.ex_cn: 他没带伞，被雨淋了。
words.en: To be involved in a situation unexpectedly or unwillingly.

words.tr: phrase. 陆续地；一个接一个地
words.ex: The children left the room one after another.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们一个接一个地离开了房间。
words.en: If things happen one after another, they happen in sequence, with little or no time in between.

words.ex: Smoking has a bad effect on your lungs.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的肺有害。
words.en: To cause a negative impact or influence on something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；领会；接待；接受
words.ex: Plants take in sunlight to make food.
words.ex_cn: 植物吸收阳光来制造食物。
words.en: To take something in means to understand it or to absorb it. It can also mean to deceive someone or to make clothes smaller.

words.tr: phrase. 分发；发出；发表；用尽
words.ex: He gives out books to the students.
words.ex_cn: 他把书分发给学生们。
words.en: To distribute or hand out something; to emit or produce something such as a sound or smell; to announce or make something known publicly.

words.tr: phrase. 简而言之；用一句话概括
words.ex: In a nutshell, he likes soccer.
words.ex_cn: 简而言之，他喜欢足球。
words.en: If you say something in a nutshell, you are describing it or explaining it in a very brief way, using just a few words.

words.ex: He looked through the book quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速翻阅了那本书。
words.en: To look through something means to examine or read it quickly or casually.

words.tr: 短语动词. 与……处于战争状态；与……激烈对抗
words.ex: The two countries are at war with each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家正在互相交战。
words.en: To be in a state of conflict or war with another party.

words.tr: phrase. 提出；教育；养育；呕出
words.ex: He brought up an important point in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上提出了一个重要的观点。
words.en: To mention a subject or start to talk about it; to care for a child until they are an adult, often giving them particular beliefs; to educate someone; to vomit.

words.ex: He become interested in birds after watching a nature show.
words.ex_cn: 他看完一个自然节目后对鸟类产生了兴趣。
words.en: To start to feel interested in something or someone.

words.ex: My mom is proud of me because I passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈为我通过考试而感到骄傲。
words.en: To feel a sense of pride or satisfaction in something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 总之；最后；综上所述
words.ex: In conclusion, we should eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 总之，我们应该多吃蔬菜。
words.en: used to introduce the final comments at the end of a speech or a piece of writing

words.ex: He smiled for the first time today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天第一次笑了。
words.en: If something happens for the first time, it has never happened before.

words.tr: phrase. 起源于；始于（某一时期）
words.ex: These old coins date from the year 1800.
words.ex_cn: 这些旧硬币可以追溯到1800年。
words.en: If something dates from a particular time, it started or was made at that time.

words.tr: phrase. 阻止；抑制；使退缩；隐瞒
words.ex: He tried to hold back his tears.
words.ex_cn: 他试图忍住眼泪。
words.en: To hold back means to prevent someone or something from moving forward or making progress, or to keep something secret or not express your feelings.

words.ex: Her dream will come true next year.
words.ex_cn: 她的梦想明年将会实现。
words.en: If a dream, hope, or prediction comes true, it actually happens.

words.tr: phrase. 讲得通； 有意义； 言之有理
words.ex: This plan makes sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划有道理。
words.en: To be reasonable or understandable.

words.tr: phrase. v. 使结束；终止（某事）
words.ex: The new law will bring an end to pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律将结束污染。
words.en: To cause something to stop or conclude.
